filter.selection: observed r with native extinction; color-dependent grz depth and original PSF, mask, error and crowding cuts, common effective random area
filter.normalization: one selected member conditional on each local observed selection

simple_baseline.features: same adjacent native gr and rz colors, same training IDs and nominal Mg labels
simple_baseline.fallback: nearest supported cell, distance and count explicitly reported
simple_baseline.intervals: conditional training Mg empirical quantiles with native band-noise propagation

noise.error_sampling: joint three-band errors from actual matched native, gr/rz color bins

predictive.likelihood: signed Gaussian Gaia with actual observed SNR windows; Gaussian VAC modulus-summary approximation for spectroscopy, SPDist intrinsic already included

stop_rules.spatial: require self recovery, background-injection scale and false-peak criteria, and stable local known-system distances at the fixed two widths and depths
stop_rules.model_expansion: only small same-input empirical baseline and same-star frozen-model experiments; no whole-catalogue retraining or prediction
stop_rules.faint: require minimum effective N and scale CI narrower than 20 percentage points to resolve a 10 percent scale
stop_rules.metallicity: no global shift adopted from a conditional descriptive measurement
